certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Building Websites with WordPress

learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish hosting, domains and the WordPress software and set up a working site
Structure content with pages, posts, categories and menus for clear navigation
Build and edit layouts with the block editor and a theme without touching code
Choose, install and configure plugins while managing their security and performance cost
Apply core security, backup and update practices to keep a site healthy
Optimise basic performance and on-page SEO and publish with confidence

integrative_case: A neighbourhood bakery needs a self-hosted site with a menu, an about page and a blog: choose hosting and a domain, install WordPress, structure the content and navigation, build the pages with blocks, add only a vetted contact-form and backup plugin, harden security, check performance and SEO basics, and publish.
design_assumption_note: n/a - general professional skills course, no external standard claimed

Platform features, pricing and user interfaces change frequently; product specifics must be verified at production and on-screen steps may differ from any shown.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
